# TEAM journey

End-to-end journey for an admin who is provisioning a new team.

## Sub-flows

- [TEAM-01](../flows/TEAM/TEAM-01.md) — Team onboarding
- [TEAM-02](../flows/TEAM/TEAM-02.md) — Team settings
- [TEAM-03](../flows/TEAM/TEAM-03.md) — Team invitations

## Narrative

A new admin signs in for the first time (TEAM-01), reviews and adjusts team-wide settings (TEAM-02), and invites the rest of the team (TEAM-03). The journey ends when at least one teammate has accepted an invite and become an active member.
